name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Elite Mastercard®

otherLounges: Alaska Airlines Board Room (when flying AA or Alaska)
loungeAccess.notes: Full Admirals Club membership included for cardholder. Immediate family (spouse/domestic partner + children under 18) or up to 2 guests admitted free. Standalone Admirals Club membership costs $850/year.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel Accident Insurance up to $500,000 when traveling as a passenger on a common carrier.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated medical evacuation benefit. Citi Concierge can assist with referrals and coordination.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto rental insurance — secondary coverage. File with personal auto insurance first.

globalEntryTSA.notes: Statement credit for Global Entry ($100) or TSA PreCheck ($85) application fee.

purchaseProtection.notes: Verify current purchase protection terms at time of application.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extended Warranty: doubles the warranty period up to 2 additional years on eligible items.

rewards.hotelRate: 10x miles on eligible hotels via AA Hotels (hotel bookings)
rewards.carRentalRate: 10x miles on eligible car rentals via AA Car Rentals
rewards.diningRate: 1x miles (no dining bonus on this card)

annualCredits.name: Authorized User Admirals Club Access
annualCredits.notes: Up to 10 authorized users can receive Admirals Club access at no additional charge per user (typically $45/user).

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation. Saves $35 per person each way.

priorityBoarding.notes: Preferred boarding in Group 4 on American Airlines flights.

inflight.notes: 25% savings on in-flight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights.

eliteStatusBenefits.mqmBonus: Earn 10,000 Elite Qualifying Miles (EQMs) after $40,000 in purchases in a calendar year.
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Loyalty Points from every purchase count toward AAdvantage elite status. EQM boost available at $40K spend.

admiralsClub.notes: Full Admirals Club membership (50+ global lounges) — valued at $850+/year standalone.

travelPerks: Full Admirals Club membership (50+ locations worldwide)
Authorized users get Admirals Club access (up to 10 users free)
First checked bag free (cardholder + up to 8 companions)
Group 4 preferred boarding on American Airlines
25% in-flight food and beverage savings (as statement credit)
10x miles on hotel/car bookings through AA Hotels/Cars
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 5 years
bestFor: Frequent American Airlines flyers who want full Admirals Club lounge membership and maximum miles earning on AA spending
